lines.en: I step out of the seal.
This end stone body is heavy.

lines.zh: 我的脚每一步都压出粉
lines.en: My feet leave dust with each step.

lines.zh: 我沿着结构的长廊前进
lines.en: I move along the structure's corridor.

lines.zh: 紫黑的光从我身上漏出
lines.en: Purple-black light leaks from me.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声,只有石头的摩擦
lines.en: No footsteps, only stone grinding.
I head toward the intruder.

lines.zh: 封印的碎片还挂在我身上
lines.en: Fragments of the seal still cling to me.
I pause, then go on.

lines.zh: 我的影子在末地石上很低
lines.en: My shadow lies low on the end stone.
I pass a broken pillar.
I walk steadily, unhurried.
I stand like a monument.
The seal's mark is on my chest.

lines.zh: 我的体内有低低的响声
lines.en: A low sound hums inside me.
The purple light pulses.

lines.zh: 我在听这个结构的呼吸
lines.en: I listen to the structure breathe.
No one has come in a long time.
There are cracks across my surface.

lines.zh: 封印还在，只是松了一角。
lines.en: The seal holds, but one corner has loosened.

lines.zh: 末地的风不吹到我身上
lines.en: The End's wind does not reach me.
I count the falling fragments.
No wind moves inside end stone.
My weight presses the slabs.

lines.zh: 你带着末影之石的气味
lines.en: You carry the scent of an ender gem.
You are the one who broke the seal.

lines.zh: 你不像解开封印的那个人。
lines.en: You don't look like the one who broke the seal.
You are smaller than I expected.

lines.zh: 紫光从封印缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Purple light leaks from the seal's seams.

lines.zh: 你唤醒的东西，比石柱还高。
lines.en: What you woke stands taller than the pillars.

lines.zh: 你站的地方原本是空的
lines.en: Where you stand was empty before.

lines.zh: 我很久没有被人这样看着
lines.en: I have not been looked at like this in ages.
You should not have opened the seal.
I am awake now.

lines.zh: 末地石铸的我，三百三十血。
lines.en: End stone wrought, three hundred thirty health.
That counts as wisdom.
I take one slow step forward.
The slabs sound under me.
The crack has reached my wrist.
The crack has grown longer.
I stepped back.
The purple light dimmed.
The sound inside me broke rhythm.
I can feel my weight lessening.
I feel no pain, only loss.
I am still standing here.
This body is crumbling.
But I have not fallen.
I never eat such things.

lines.zh: 你举起来的东西不是末影之石
lines.en: That is not an ender gem.

lines.zh: 我只对一种东西有反应
lines.en: Only one thing draws my attention.
You do not have it.
Then there is nothing to discuss.

lines.zh: 我抬手,不是为了接东西
lines.en: I raise my hand, but not to take.
Put it down first.

lines.zh: 它在我眼里什么都不是
lines.en: It means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我要的是解封我的那一块。
lines.en: I want the stone that sealed me.
Do not stand before me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上,像撞石头
lines.en: You hit me like stone.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，碎末落了一肩。
lines.en: You hit me, and dust settles on your shoulders.
My surface does not shift.
You are thrown back two steps.
End stone is hardly light.
You touched one of my cracks.

lines.zh: 末地石做的我，三百三十点命。
lines.en: End stone body, three hundred thirty points.
That force is not enough.
I blocked you.
Get back from before me.
Things sealed away do not fall in love.
But I can stay my hand.
You may stand beside me.

lines.zh: 这块石板够我们两个站
lines.en: This slab is wide enough for two.
The End has no daylight.

lines.zh: 你可以听我体内的声音
lines.en: You may listen to the sound inside me.
It has never stopped.
I have no need to speak.
Let us stay like this.
Do not walk away from here.
I bend; my stone cracks audibly.
It is too small for me to see.
I squeeze, and it breaks.
I do not need this.
I push it into a seam.
It has nothing to do with the seal.
This stone is of no use to me.
I straighten my body.
It lies under my feet.
It is in the way before my feet.

lines.zh: 你唤醒了不该唤醒的东西
lines.en: You woke what should have slept.
The broken seal woke me.
The seal is broken.

lines.zh: 我在这个结构里等了很久
lines.en: I have waited in this structure a long time.

lines.zh: 末地石封着我，你解开了。
lines.en: End stone sealed me; you broke the seal.
I raise my whole arm.
You are the first to come.
The slabs have begun to tremble.
Only you are in this corridor.

lines.zh: 末地石封着我，没人来开。
lines.en: End stone seals me. No one comes to open it.
Run. Run right now.
I will not chase beyond this structure.
My weight holds everything down.
Then let it begin.
I follow you around the corridor.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿,石板就响到哪儿
lines.en: Wherever you run, the slabs sound.

lines.zh: 这个结构只有一个出口
lines.en: This structure has only one exit.
And I stand on that path.
The sound inside me has grown.
The purple light is brightening.
You are hiding behind a pillar.
A pillar will not stop my weight.

lines.zh: 碎石不断从我身上落下
lines.en: Fragments keep falling from me.
Every step costs me a piece.
But I can still walk.
Your retreat keeps shortening.
Only two pillars between us.

lines.zh: 我停下来,让它安静一下
lines.en: I stop, to let it be quiet.
Now it sounds again.
My arm comes down.
A crater opens in the slabs.

lines.zh: 碎石跳起来，打在你身上。
lines.en: Chips leap up and strike you.
A piece of stone falls off me.
This blow was very slow.
The slabs shatter behind you.
End stone fragments scatter.

lines.zh: 我退了一步,重新举起手臂
lines.en: I step back and raise my arm again.

lines.zh: 末地石的拳头，比你的盾沉。
lines.en: An end stone fist outweighs your shield.

lines.zh: 末地石的躯体，碎了也能拼回来。
lines.en: An end-stone body can piece itself back.
If you come closer...
I will press you into this floor.
The seal splits first.
Purple light leaks through the crack.
End stone begins to join.
My form takes shape, piece by piece.
The slabs sink beneath my weight.
My head lifts.
The whole corridor is sounding.

lines.zh: 封印的碎片落在我脚边
lines.en: Seal fragments fall at my feet.
I open my eyes; there are no pupils.

lines.zh: 你手里的末影之石在发亮
lines.en: The ender gem in your hand is glowing.
So that was the key.

lines.zh: 末地石缝里，我等了太久。
lines.en: In the End stone cracks I waited too long.
Halt. Do not take another step.
End stone burns white.
I crash down and shatter.
Water seeps into my cracks.
The blast tore a corner off me.

lines.zh: 箭杆断在石缝里，拔不出。
lines.en: The shaft snaps in my joint and will not come out.

lines.zh: 那股力量撞上了封印的残痕
lines.en: That force strikes the seal's remnant.

lines.zh: 没有末影之石,我撑不了太久
lines.en: Without the gem, I will not last long.
Lightning runs into my cracks.
There are no slabs to stand on.
